summary: Ling 3.1 Flash is InclusionAI's hybrid-reasoning MoE model: 560B total parameters, 25B active, 262K context and 32K max output on gateways, with reasoning and tool calling. Vercel AI Gateway offers it free through 2026-10-13 under two model IDs: inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash (starts billing when the promotion ends) and inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash-free (stops serving instead of billing). Kilo Code lists it at $0.00/1M 'currently available at no cost', and OpenCode Zen serves a ling-3.1-flash-free endpoint at $0.00/$0.00.
claim_steps: Get a Vercel AI Gateway API key (or sign in with Vercel in a supported coding agent)
Call the gateway with model ID inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash or inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash-free before 2026-10-13
For coding agents, run the AI Gateway agent setup, then /model and pick Ling 3.1 Flash; in Kilo Code or OpenCode Zen select the listed ling-3.1-flash(-free) model
